title: the last mile: real streets from the I-5 exits into Vega & Vinnie’s lot and back to the on-ramps, with a seamless car handoff
lensAText: a sceptical driving-game systems reviewer and a mapping purist. Read /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Claude/104ede24-b5bc-5131-bb4c-1bc7e86a4fd2/scratchpad/wf/brief-lastmile.md and src/data/anaheim/sportsbar-freeway-link.json. Look at every frame the builder cites with the Read tool, then build dist/artifact.html yourself and run ONE short Playwright script with the window.__game hooks at 1280x720 and 390x844 (phone viewport copy, DPR 3): Go To the venue from the I-5 N Disney Way/Katella exit and from the I-5 S Katella/Orangewood exit on Auto-drive, Get out, walk to the car, Drive, and Auto-drive back to both on-ramps. Judge: do the streets match the real network (names, one-ways, the signal at Katella/Anaheim Way, speed limits from the data); does the car park near the door; is the handoff seamless both ways (no black frame, pose kept within 0.1 m / 2 deg, no 'street driving isn't built yet' toast); do the longer exits still label honestly; phone budgets near the venue. Reject on invented streets, a fade to black, a pose jump, or a regression in boot/venues/nav-hud/phone.
